correctness.rationale: PASS: for every n>=3 and 1<=k<=floor(n/2), the edge-difference isometry identifies real Lip_0(C_n) with the zero-sum hyperplane H_n of l_infinity^n. Rotation averaging any projection onto the real k-harmonic makes the equivariant Fourier projection optimal among all projections: the abelian shift representation has unique frequency eigenspaces and the identity multiplier on the range. Its norm on H_n is (2/n) min_c sum_j |cos(2*pi*k*j/n)-c| (for m>=3) by H_n^* = l_1^n/span(1), and gcd reduction gives order m=n/gcd(n,k). Evaluating cosine medians by residue class yields exactly the stated odd, 2 mod 4 and 0 mod 4 trigonometric formulas; the real alternating one-dimensional m=2 case has norm 1. Directly evaluating m=3,4 and strict elementary inequalities for m>=5 gives contractivity iff 2,3,4; small-angle limits give 4/pi. Independently checked the claimed median formula for 298 character orders m=3..300; the all-n result comes from cyclic symmetrization, quotient duality and geometric-series identities, not numerical extrapolation.
